senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced.) a woman in confinement; a mother.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:8">Ab. II, 8</cite> <he>אשרי יוֹלַדְתּוֹ</he> blessed is his mother.—Pl. <he>יוֹלְדוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 32a:8">Sabb. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>נשים מתות י׳</he> women die in confinement (v. <cite ref="L00430"><he>לֵידָה</he></cite>); Y. ib. II, 5ᵇ top; v. <he>יַלְדָּה</he>.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 1:5">Sot. I, 5</cite> <he>את הי׳</he> (not <cite ref="J00188"><he>יולדת</he></cite>) the women appearing in the Temple after confinement.
